newsitem.title: GERMANY: German trade seeks free mkt wheat, barley rebates.
newsitem.headline: German trade seeks free mkt wheat, barley rebates.

text.p: German grain traders are seeking to export 123,000 tonnes of free market barley with restitutions in a 27.91-32.95 Ecus a tonne range, the state grain intervention board BLE said on Thursday.
BLE also received bids for the export of 9,000 tonnes of free market soft wheat, where the envisaged rebates were between 18.32 and 21.50 Ecus per tonne, BLE said.
The bids will be discussed at the weekly EU cereals management committee meeting later today.
